description: 한국철도공사_역 운영현황 및 영업거리 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 이 데이터는 한국철도공사가 매년 발행하는 철도통계연보에 수록된 자료로, 연도별로 전국 철도역의 수와 영업거리(각 역의 영업에 사용되는 철도 노선의 총 거리)를 구분, 종별, 수량,. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 연도별 철도역 수, 영업거리 변화, 철도 인프라 증감, 역 운영 현황, 노선 연장 영향. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
